title: Goa Coastal Unwind & Beach Escape
cost_summary: Estimated total cost of ₹35,000 for 2 people covering beachfront resort, meals at shacks, scooter rental, and water activities.
budget_advice: Rent a scooty for ₹400/day instead of taxis to save 70% on local transit. Eat at local South Goa beach shacks for fresh seafood at reasonable prices.

itinerary.title: Arrival in North Goa & Vagator Sunset
itinerary.summary: Touchdown at Dabolim/Mopa airport, check into your boutique resort, and spend a peaceful evening watching the sunset at Vagator Beach.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Smooth 45-min taxi drive from airport to Vagator resort; 10-min walk to the beach cliffs.
itinerary.weather_note: Pleasant coastal breeze, 28°C. Perfect for outdoor sunset seating.
itinerary.notes: Head to Chapora Fort around 5:15 PM for prime golden-hour photos.

itinerary.title: Heritage Panjim & Fontainhas Latin Quarter
itinerary.summary: Explore the colorful Portuguese architecture of Fontainhas, take a Mandovi river sunset cruise, and indulge in Goan fish curry.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Ride scooty 25 mins south from Vagator to Panjim along the picturesque NH66.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm morning (30°C); carry water and wear breathable cotton clothes for walking.
itinerary.notes: Stop by Joseph Bar in Fontainhas for craft beer and local snacks in the evening.

itinerary.title: South Goa Serenity & Palolem Beach Kayaking
itinerary.summary: Escape the bustle to tranquil South Goa. Enjoy early morning kayaking among dolphins at Palolem and relax at Agonda Beach.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Scenic 1.5 hr coastal drive south to Palolem; scenic palm-fringed roads throughout.
itinerary.weather_note: Sunny and clear skies (29°C); ideal water clarity for kayaking.
itinerary.notes: Book a guided kayak session early morning (7:30 AM) for dolphin sightings.

itinerary.title: Spice Plantation Tour & Dudhsagar Waterfall Drive
itinerary.summary: Visit an organic spice plantation in Ponda with authentic buffet lunch, followed by a scenic drive towards the Western Ghats foothills.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Drive inland 40 mins toward Ponda; well-paved interior roads lined with lush greenery.
itinerary.weather_note: Slightly cooler inland near forest trails (26°C); light humidity.
itinerary.notes: Spice plantation ticket includes a guided botanical walkthrough and traditional thali.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping in Anjuna & Departure
itinerary.summary: Pick up cashew nuts, feni, and handmade souvenirs at Anjuna market before a final lazy brunch and departure flight.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 15-min ride around Anjuna/Baga, then 50-min taxi drive to airport for flight home.
itinerary.weather_note: Sunny afternoon (31°C). Check out by 11 AM and enjoy sea breeze at Artjuna.
itinerary.notes: Allow 2 hours airport arrival time as security queues can be busy.

title: Royal Rajasthan Forts & Heritage Trail
cost_summary: Estimated total budget of ₹60,000 for 2 people including heritage hotel stays, fort entries, guided heritage walks, and royal Rajasthani dining.
budget_advice: Buy a composite monument pass in Jaipur to save 40% on entry tickets. Travel between Jaipur, Jodhpur, and Udaipur via express trains for fast & cheap transit.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur Pink City & Hawa Mahal
itinerary.summary: Arrive in Jaipur, check into a restored heritage Haveli, and embark on an afternoon street walk through Johari Bazaar to see Hawa Mahal.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 25-min taxi from Jaipur airport to Pink City old market quarter.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm dry climate (27°C); comfortable evening air.
itinerary.notes: Try Pyaz Kachori at Rawat and Ghewar at LMB market.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort Elephant Hill & Jal Mahal Sunset
itinerary.summary: Explore the magnificent hilltop Amber Fort, marvel at Sheesh Mahal mirrors, and stop by Jal Mahal lake for golden hour.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 30-min scenic drive north from city center to Amer hills.
itinerary.weather_note: Sunny morning (29°C); wear a wide-brim hat for open fort courtyards.
itinerary.notes: Hire an official audio guide at Amber Fort for fascinating architectural history.

itinerary.title: City Palace Jaipur & Express Train to Jodhpur
itinerary.summary: Visit the royal City Palace museum and Jantar Mantar observatory before boarding the afternoon express train to the Blue City Jodhpur.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 10-min rickshaw to Jaipur Junction; 4.5-hr executive train ride to Jodhpur.
itinerary.weather_note: Pleasant train ride; clear evening in Jodhpur (24°C).
itinerary.notes: Jodhpur Stepwell Cafe overlooks an ancient illuminated baori.

itinerary.title: Mehrangarh Fort & Blue City Heritage Alley Walk
itinerary.summary: Tour the imposing Mehrangarh Fort perched 400ft above Jodhpur, walk through blue-painted lanes of Navchokiya, and watch sunset at Jaswant Thada.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Auto-rickshaw up the winding fort road (15 mins); foot walk through blue lanes.
itinerary.weather_note: Bright desert sun (28°C); fort museum rooms are air-conditioned.
itinerary.notes: Mehrangarh museum audio tour is widely considered one of India's best.

itinerary.title: Drive to Udaipur via Ranakpur Jain Temple
itinerary.summary: Private car drive south through the Aravalli hills to Udaipur, stopping to marvel at the 1,444 marble pillars of Ranakpur Temple.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 5-hr car journey through scenic Aravalli mountain passes.
itinerary.weather_note: Cooler mountain breeze in Aravallis (23°C).
itinerary.notes: Ranakpur temple requires shoes and leather items to be deposited at entry.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Lake Pichola Boat Cruise
itinerary.summary: Marvel at Rajasthan's largest royal palace complex, visit Jagmandir island palace by boat, and enjoy romantic dining overlooking Lake Pichola.
itinerary.route_suggestion: Walking distance around Lal Ghat and Old Udaipur lakeshore.
itinerary.weather_note: Serene lakeside evening (22°C); delightful romantic atmosphere.
packing: Formal Evening Outfit for Lake Dinner
itinerary.notes: Pre-book Ambrai lakeside table for 7 PM to get prime palace lighting views.

itinerary.title: Saheliyon Ki Bari & Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.summary: Stroll through the lush gardens and fountains of Saheliyon Ki Bari, shop for miniature paintings, and head to Maharana Pratap Airport.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 40-min taxi drive from lake district to Udaipur airport.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm morning (26°C); peaceful garden shade.
packing: Souvenir Padding / Bubble Wrap for Handicrafts
itinerary.notes: Buy authentic Udaipur silver jewelry and Pichwai paintings at Hathi Pol.

title: Manali & Solang Valley Alpine Expedition
cost_summary: Estimated total cost of ₹25,000 for group of 4 covering Volvo bus from Delhi, mountain cabin stay, paragliding at Solang, and trek gear.
budget_advice: Book Volvo bus tickets 2 weeks in advance. Group paragliding and snow scooter packages at Solang can be bargained down by 25%.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Old Manali & Jogini Waterfall Trek
itinerary.summary: Reach Manali via overnight Volvo, settle into Old Manali cabin, and take a warm-up 3-km forest trek to Jogini Waterfalls.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 15-min autorickshaw from Manali bus stand to Old Manali village.
itinerary.weather_note: Crisp mountain air (14°C day / 6°C night); sunny trail weather.
itinerary.notes: Stop for fresh trout fish and hot apple cider at Johnson's Cafe.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Paragliding & Snow Sports
itinerary.summary: Head up to Solang Valley for high-adrenaline tandem paragliding, ATV rides, and cable car rides with panoramic Himalayan views.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 45-min jeep ride north along the Beas River to Solang Valley base.
itinerary.weather_note: Chilly wind gusts at altitude (10°C); wear windproof outer layer.
itinerary.notes: Verify paraglider pilot certification (HP Tourism approved) before flight.

itinerary.title: Atal Tunnel & Sissu Lahaul Valley Expedition
itinerary.summary: Drive through the engineering marvel Atal Tunnel (9 km) into the stark, breathtaking landscape of Sissu in Lahaul Valley.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 1.5-hr jeep drive through Atal Tunnel into trans-Himalayan Lahaul.
itinerary.weather_note: Significant drop in temperature north of tunnel (5°C to 8°C); heavy jackets required.
itinerary.notes: Carry cash as cellular network and ATMs are limited beyond the tunnel.

itinerary.title: Vashisht Hot Springs & Mall Road Souvenirs
itinerary.summary: Soak sore muscles in natural sulfur hot springs at Vashisht, shop for Himachali shawls on Mall Road, and board evening bus back.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 10-min ride to Vashisht springs; 10-min walk to Mall Road bus depot.
itinerary.weather_note: Cool afternoon (16°C); soothing warm bath springs.
itinerary.notes: Vashisht hot springs have separate clean enclosures for men and women.

title: Kerala Backwaters & Tea Garden Serenity
cost_summary: Estimated total cost of ₹50,000 for 2 people including private luxury houseboat with all meals, tea resort in Munnar, and authentic Ayurvedic massage.
budget_advice: Book houseboats directly from Alleppey jetty operators to save 20% commission. Choose mid-week stays for luxury tea estate resorts.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Scenic Drive to Munnar
itinerary.summary: Land at Cochin Airport and take a picturesque drive past Cheeyappara Waterfalls into the emerald tea hills of Munnar.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 3.5-hr winding mountain drive from Cochin Airport (COK) to Munnar town.
itinerary.weather_note: Pleasant mist and cool hill climate (18°C); refreshingly fresh air.
itinerary.notes: Stop at Cheeyappara falls for fresh coconut water and banana chips.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estate Walk & Eravikulam Sanctuary
itinerary.summary: Walk through rolling tea gardens, visit the Lockhart Tea Factory museum, and spot endangered Nilgiri Tahr goats at Rajamalai.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 20-min drive to Rajamalai park entrance; park safari buses take you to the top.
itinerary.weather_note: Misty morning (15°C); mild sunshine by noon.
itinerary.notes: Book Eravikulam entry tickets online to avoid 1-hour ticket counter lines.

itinerary.title: Spice Country Thekkady & Periyar Lake Boat Safari
itinerary.summary: Drive south to Thekkady (Periyar), take a bamboo raft or boat safari on Periyar Lake, and enjoy a traditional Kalaripayattu martial arts show.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 3-hr scenic mountain drive from Munnar to Thekkady along Cardamom Hills.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm forest breeze (24°C); tropical greenery.
itinerary.notes: Evening Kalaripayattu and Kathakali cultural shows run from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat Check-in & Backwater Cruise
itinerary.summary: Board your luxury private Kettuvallam houseboat at Punnamada Jetty. Glide through serene palm-fringed canals while enjoying fresh Karimeen fish thali.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 3.5-hr drive down to Alleppey Jetty; check-in at 12:00 PM on houseboat.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm, sunny backwater afternoon (28°C); gentle water breeze.
itinerary.notes: Houseboat anchors by 5:30 PM in quiet village lagoon for overnight stay under stars.

itinerary.title: Ayurvedic Rejuvenation Spa & Marari Beach Sunset
itinerary.summary: Disembark houseboat after breakfast, experience a traditional Abhyanga oil massage at an Ayurvedic center, and relax on quiet Marari Beach.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 30-min coastal drive north from Alleppey to Marari Beach.
itinerary.weather_note: Warm beach day (29°C); soothing ocean breeze.
packing: Hair Clip / Scarf for Massage Oil
itinerary.notes: Ayurvedic Abhyanga massage uses warm herb-infused oils for deep muscle relaxation.

itinerary.title: Fort Kochi Heritage & Chinese Fishing Nets Departure
itinerary.summary: Drive up to Fort Kochi, explore Jew Town antiquities, see the 500-year-old Chinese Fishing Nets, and head to Kochi Airport.
itinerary.route_suggestion: 1-hr drive from Marari to Fort Kochi; 1-hr taxi from Fort Kochi to Airport.
itinerary.weather_note: Humid coastal weather (30°C); shaded heritage lanes.
itinerary.notes: Kashi Art Cafe serves outstanding organic coffee and chocolate cake in a garden court.
